note: Ten typed follows read by deepseek-flash (temperature 0, thinking off) on 2026-10-25 and matched by frontierFollowMatches against the controller's three production samples of 2026-10-18..25 (11,844 published items: scored-7d, track-items-30d, study-items) in a throwaway database. Each match was labelled by hand from its title: yes = the item is about what was typed, partly = it is near it or names it in passing, no = it is not about it. concepts[] says how each concept of the follow was satisfied: key (an entity key), title (a name in the title) or text (a name only in the summary, entities or tags). The labels are one reader's; the model's reading varies a little between runs, so `answer` is the reading that was labelled. Recall was not measured, except by spot checks named in the hand-off.
